primary_finding: The source directory authorization requests KAUTH_VNODE_DELETE | KAUTH_VNODE_ADD_SUBDIRECTORY even with the same parent. This source evidence is consistent with the actual EACCES at rename on a 0555 source root. Exact runner kernel version was not matched.
change: Leave outer staging directory writable through rename, then seal final root to0555, sync it and parent. Contents remain sealed before rename. No sync fallback, ACL relaxation or test skip.
reader_audit: resolve_catalog_release validates release_root and bin immutable before manifest/program reads. allow_release and resolve_release pass through that validator. The final name can be briefly visible but readers reject the writable root. This is not atomic ready publication.
failure_semantics: Rename failure retains old staging cleanup.
Post-rename seal failure returns error and may leave a writable final root which readers reject. Existing-name guard requires explicit recovery; no overwrite retry or blind deletion of final name.
Post-seal sync failure returns error and may leave an admissible complete tree, as with prior post-rename sync failures. No success or durability claim is made.
This patch does not certify concurrent installer ownership, adversarial same-owner mutation, or replace the existing path-based filesystem threat model.
regression: Existing read-only-source+duplicate-install test retained. Added immutable root/bin checks, no staging residue comparison, explicit writable final-root rejection and successful restored sealed resolution equality.
